title: The biggest opportunity in consumer finance is the customer every other card program rejects
summary: Find out how consumer fintechs can reach the customers every other card program rejects — with a 2-minute onboarding flow, cash-flow underwriting, and infrastructure built to grow as fast as your ambitions do.
body_markdown: Consumer fintechs targeting underserved borrowers — thin files, no credit history, locked out by traditional scoring — face a different kind of infrastructure challenge: how do you approve more customers faster without sacrificing compliance, and how do you ship new product features without being held hostage by your banking stack? The answer isn't a better credit bureau. It's a platform built from the ground up for cash-flow underwriting and rapid iteration.Download our[case study](https://www.treasuryprime.com/blog/assets/6a0497f5426a6d0c4c64656c.pdf) to see how one consumer card program went from zero to 2.35 million accounts in under 60 days — with $59.7M in deposits and 40%+ of platform activity running through ACH — and learn how Treasury Prime's FBO account infrastructure, RTP/FedNow pathway, and KYC integrations can help your program scale just as fast.
